name: @kitchensink/edge-verifier
//: The CloudFront viewer-request decision (ADR-0020) as its own package, so it adopts the shared CORS policy
as one artifact the bearer-only guard can scan (ADR-0047). `packages/infra/global` bundles `./verifier`
into the Lambda@Edge asset with esbuild; no image installs this package, so it has no prod.package.json.
`./routes` imports nothing, so `EdgeStack` can read it at synth without loading `@clerk/backend`.
`cors` is pinned to the version `@nestjs/platform-express` pins: the unit suite uses it as the oracle.
